kpis.name: Recoveries
kpis.description: Number of ball recoveries of a team in open play per match.

kpis.name: Recovery line height (m)
kpis.description: Average height on the pitch that a team recovered the ball per match.

kpis.name: Possessions retained after 5s
kpis.description: Number of possessions by a team that lasted longer than 5 seconds after recovering the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Possessions retained after 5s %
kpis.description: Percentage of possessions by a team that lasted longer than 5 seconds after recovering the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions of a team that successfully reached the final third within 10 seconds after an open play ball recovery per match.
kpis.display_name: Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: Possessions to box within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions of a team that entered the penalty area following an open play ball recovery per match.
kpis.display_name: Possessions to box within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: xG within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of goals that a team should be expected to score statistically considering the quality of their chances within 10 seconds after an open play ball recovery per match.

kpis.name: xT within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Expected offensive contribution by a team considering the quality of their actions within 10 seconds after an open play ball recovery per match.
